title: Fix Sourcing React Plugin Module Mime Types
description: Make sure sourcing react works end to end. Fix MIME type errors for module scripts served from plugin-modules static dir.
summary:
Fixed sourcing react end-to-end boot failures caused by plugin-modules static assets being served without JavaScript/WASM Content-Type headers.

**Root cause:** `staticDirVitePlugin`'s `contentTypeForStaticDirAsset` only handled images/PDFs. Preview2-shim vendor files (`cli.js`, `clocks.js`, `io.js`, …) and plugin entrypoints served under `/plugin-modules/_vendor` and `/plugin-modules/sourcing` returned empty MIME types, so dynamic `import()` failed strict module-script checking.

**Fixes:**
- Extended `contentTypeForStaticDirAsset` with `text/javascript` (`.js`/`.mjs`), `application/wasm` (`.wasm`), and `application/json` (`.json`).
- Added vitest coverage for plugin-module mime mapping.
- `DevScript` now calls `ensurePluginRegistry` when `SKIP_PLUGIN_BUILD=1` so `generated/session.ts` always matches the active `SEMIO_PLUGIN` (was leaving a stale `puzzle3d` session on the sourcing port).
- Regenerated sourcing playground session.
- Fixed `🛠️dev🛒️sourcing⚛️react` launch config to use `S_OS_PORT` instead of unused `SOURCING_PLAY_PORT`.

**Verification:** Restarted sourcing react dev on :6081; curl confirms `text/javascript` and `application/wasm` headers; Playwright smoke test loads with title `semio · sourcing · curate` and no plugin/MIME console errors.
